paragraphs.text: The Mist Moon is Dominaria 's large, natural moon, not to be confused with the Null- or Glimmer Moon .

The Mist Moon is named after the mists that constantly shroud its murky atmosphere. It is also called Fessa , the Great Moon , the Greater Moon , the Lady , and the Pearl Moon among merfolk worshippers of Svyelun .
Every twenty-eight days, when the Mist Moon reaches its full phase, devotees of Svyelun are obligated to spend the night in ritual contemplation.
Lady Evangela is associated with the Mist Moon, and is depicted riding a rainbow to the moon on a mosaic at the College of Lat-Nam .
